package saga

import (
	"context"
	corenest "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestReviewReceiptPrunedWhileRetryBudgetStillOpen(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	entity := newReceiptEntity()
	committer := &receiptCommitter{}
	targetEffects := 0
	first := stepCommand(0, 1, 10*time.Second)
	run := func(cmd Command, at time.Time) StepOutcome {
		state := newNativeRun(cmd, time.Minute)
		state.now = func() time.Time { return at }
		step := NativeStep{command: cmd, run: state}
		_, err := corenest.RunIsolatedTransaction(context.Background(), committer, "review", func() (any, error) {
			if replay, err := step.Begin(entity); replay || err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if cmd.IdempotencyKey == first.IdempotencyKey {
				targetEffects++
			}
			return nil, step.Complete(true, "")
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return state.result()
	}
	run(first, now) // 业务生效，但结果尚未送回协调器。
	unrelated := stepCommand(0, 1, time.Hour)
	unrelated.SagaID = "other"
	unrelated.IdempotencyKey = operationKey("other", PhaseForward, 0)
	unrelated.ID = commandID(unrelated.IdempotencyKey, 0, 1)
	run(unrelated, now.Add(61*time.Second)) // 同实体另一笔业务按真实 Complete 路径剪掉一分钟前的回执。
	retry := first
	retry.Attempt = 4
	retry.ID = commandID(first.IdempotencyKey, 0, 4)
	retry.CreatedAt = now.Add(60 * time.Second)
	retry.DeadlineAt = now.Add(70 * time.Second)
	result := run(retry, now.Add(62*time.Second)) // 10s 超时 + 10s 退避下，第四次尝试的合法期限。
	if targetEffects != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("same operation took effect %d times; retry kind=%d after receipt pruning at 61s, while 190s retry budget remains open", targetEffects, result.Kind)
	}
}
